<a id="where-a-move-is-formed--动作在哪里形成"></a>
# Where a move is formed

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-a-move-is-formed` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](where-a-move-is-formed.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> One move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest: it is the part's exactly where it is the part's policy, the rest's likewise, both only if constant; every run is a part's course whose moves a rest forms; a course fixes whose move it is only where a configuration recurs with the move varied.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A part and the rest are coupled by one move formed within the whole (the synchronized product, the move read off the joint configuration): both take one move at every step, what the part does being what the rest undergoes; the coupled whole is the product's closedBy, the move read off rather than read in; a coupling of determined laws is determined. (`Becoming.coupled`, `Becoming.Run.part`, `Becoming.Run.rest`, `Becoming.Run.part_act_eq_rest_act`, `Becoming.Run.toClosedBy`, `Becoming.closedBy_formed`, `Becoming.Run.ofClosedBy`, `Becoming.Run.ofClosedBy_toClosedBy`, `Becoming.coupled_determined`)
2. A move is formed through a reading of the configuration where it goes alike across what the reading lumps (Learning.Lumped): a move formed within the whole is formed through the whole's configuration, one formed through a reading is formed through every reading telling apart at least as much, and through a reading telling nothing apart only a move that is the same everywhere is formed. (`Becoming.lumped_id`, `Becoming.lumped_of_finer`, `Becoming.lumped_const_iff`)
3. The move is the part's exactly where it is a policy of the part, the rest's exactly where it is a policy of the rest, and both exactly where it is the same everywhere, so a move that differs anywhere is formed by at most one of them alone. (`Becoming.PartForms`, `Becoming.RestForms`, `Becoming.partForms_iff`, `Becoming.restForms_iff`, `Becoming.partForms_and_restForms_iff`)
4. Where the part's law is determined and the move is the part's, the part carries a law of its own and its course is the same whatever the rest; where the laws are functions, each side's course is the trajectory of the standard model with the move as input, the part's own move goes round within the part and is the rest's input, and the whole goes round by one determined law. (`Becoming.PartForms.goAlike`, `Becoming.PartForms.parts_agree`, `Becoming.Run.part_trajectory`, `Becoming.Run.rest_trajectory`, `Becoming.Run.part_orbit`, `Becoming.Run.rest_orbit`, `Becoming.Run.rest_driven_by_part`, `Becoming.wholeNext`, `Becoming.Run.whole_orbit`)
5. Every run of a labelled process, whatever its moves, is the part's course in a whole of one action whose rest, a clock, forms the moves; in a course's standard model, the act of a law that reads nothing is formed through the stage alone. (`Becoming.clock`, `Becoming.clock_determined`, `Becoming.Run.withClock`, `Becoming.Run.withClock_part`, `Becoming.Run.withClock_restForms`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ofMoves_lumped_stage`)
6. Where the laws are functions, moves formed by a whole, a rest or a part held by a list repeat from some step with some period, start and period within the list's length; conversely every lasso is formed by a rest of its positions; so moves that never settle into a cycle need a former that no list holds. (`Becoming.Run.moves_lasso_of_rest_held`, `Becoming.Run.moves_lasso_of_part_held`, `Becoming.Run.moves_lasso_of_whole_held`, `Becoming.Run.whole_unheld_of_never_cycles`, `Becoming.Run.rest_unheld_of_never_cycles`, `Becoming.Run.part_unheld_of_never_cycles`, `Becoming.lassoRest`, `Becoming.Run.withLasso`, `Becoming.Run.withLasso_held`, `Becoming.Run.withLasso_part`)
7. Along a course the moves are formed through the configurations exactly where some relation giving at most one move at each configuration gives them, with no decision; where nothing recurs every reading fits, a part keeping its history reading every move as its own; where the part recurs with the move varied, the rest differs there. (`Becoming.lumped_of_new`, `Becoming.not_lumped_of_varied`, `Becoming.lumped_iff_singleValued`, `Becoming.reading_le`, `Becoming.rest_differs_of_varied`, `Becoming.Coupling.zero_add`, `Becoming.Coupling.succ_add`, `Becoming.Coupling.succ_sub_succ`, `Becoming.Coupling.add_sub_left`, `Becoming.Run.keepHistory_formed`)
8. On a finite stretch with equality of configurations decided, the moves are given by a policy of the configuration exactly where they never differ at one configuration; with equality of moves decided too, no policy gives them exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied. (`Becoming.policyUpto`, `Becoming.policyUpto_agrees`, `Becoming.lumped_upto_iff`, `Becoming.throughout_or_fails`, `Becoming.policyUpto_taken`, `Becoming.no_policy_upto_iff`)
9. Witnesses: one course admitted by the part's law of the move and by the rest's, which differ only where it never goes; a part to whose law the move makes no difference, closed against the rest while its move is the rest's; a part standing still while the move alternates, which does not form it; a move formed by whether the two differ, formed by neither alone. (`Becoming.Coupling.alt`, `Becoming.Coupling.ne_not`, `Becoming.Coupling.alt_ne`, `Becoming.TwoClocks.byPart`, `Becoming.TwoClocks.byRest`, `Becoming.TwoClocks.together`, `Becoming.TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`, `Becoming.TwoClocks.closed_not_own`, `Becoming.Still.driven`, `Becoming.Parity.partCourse`, `Becoming.Parity.restCourse`, `Becoming.Parity.form`, `Becoming.Parity.move`, `Becoming.Parity.neither_alone`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the part's law determined (Determined), the laws functions (each step's successor given by a function), the configurations within a list; decided equality of configurations and of moves only for the policy and the exclusion on a finite stretch.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which cut of an actual unfolding into part and rest is apt, or that an actual move is the part's own: the part and the rest are given (the two factors of the product).
- Run.withClock takes the run's moves as the rest's data: it shows that every move can be read as formed within a whole, not that an actual unfolding has such a rest, or which. Witness: `Becoming.Run.withClock`.
- One course does not fix whose move it is: one course is admitted by the part's law of the move and by the rest's. Witness: `Becoming.TwoClocks.one_course_two_laws`.
- Being closed against the rest does not imply that the move is one's own. Witness: `Becoming.TwoClocks.closed_not_own`.
- Which successor a law that is not determined takes: the coupling forms the move, not the successor.
- How much of a move a part forms (a measure of coupling); the counterfactual's act read through the part's own registration (ExchangeLaw.Through is stated for the formations outside the part); continuous time.
- That "one move, two sides" goes beyond the definition: part_act_eq_rest_act holds by rfl; the content is in which laws admit the move (one_course_two_laws, closed_not_own) and when a course fixes whose it is. Witness: `Becoming.Run.part_act_eq_rest_act`.
- **Counterexample:** Parity: the move is whether the part and the rest differ; along the course it is formed through neither the part's configurations nor the rest's, only through the joint configuration: not every move is one side's. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Coupling.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026, on law and history as one unfolding read two ways: “yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”; 14 October 2026, on the relation-first re-founding: “please, finish all”. This result answers the next_delta of process-and-frame-as-readings and counterfactual-is-the-course: when a move is formed within the unfolding (it can always be read so, its rest forming it) and when it is the part's own (exactly where it is formed through the part's configuration; one course fixes this only where a configuration recurs with the move varied). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): acting and undergoing are one move read from its two sides; an input is the rest's configuration, and a label from outside is a move whose forming the representation leaves out; whose move it is, is a claim about courses not taken; reading more, more is one's own; closed is not own; novelty in what is done needs openness or growth.

Answers the measure in its next step for laws of exchange: the coupling strengths measure coupling, and the part's share of a move is at most its strengths times the part's change (ExchangeLaw.exchangeGap_le_shares); the link to this record's runs is not yet stated.
